conventions.convention: The cyclotomic relation is imposed on the FIRST strand; induction appends on the RIGHT. The standard graded choice is a_i(u)=u^{λ_i}, with λ_i≥0. Arbitrary monic polynomials of those degrees give the separately stated ungraded deformation. The vacuum block is k even when every λ_i is zero.

Internal shifts satisfy (M{r})_d=M_{d-r}, and q acts by shift {1}. Basic induction is Be⊗_A− and basic restriction is e(−), through a unital corner homomorphism that need not be injective and may have zero target corner.

The native equal-color crossing is τ=(1−s)/(x−y); source crossings are κ=−τ for every color pair. The formal H_i is basic restriction shifted at its INPUT weight h by −d_i(1+h), rather than unshifted restriction.

Clockwise literal-dot count b has A-index b+h+1; counterclockwise count b has H-index b−h+1. Negative coefficient indices vanish, index zero is one, and fake bubbles are inverse-series coefficients. Opposite-crossing corrections have literal total a+b+c=−2; single curls have a+b=−1.

At root β, projective and canonical module actions use F_i=F_i basic and E_i=q_i^(−1−h_i(β))E_i basic. The KK module action instead uses E_i basic and q_i^(1−h_i(β))F_i basic. The tensor pairing T is bilinear; homogeneous Hom is first-bar-sesquilinear, with h(P,M)=T(P#,M).

Normalized projectives are self-dual for projective Hom duality P#=HOM_B(P,B)^ψ; normalized simples are self-dual for finite vector duality D_ψ. These dualities differ by the symmetric defect shift on projectives, and Hom duality is not applied to a simple to construct its cover.

A fixed distinguished-i sideways mate pair has scalar t_ij in both composition orders. The separately distinguished-j pair has scalar t_ji. For a native crossing with bottom pair (i,j) and i directed SW to NE, the assembled double-right-mate and closure ratio is t_ij/t_ji.

The global-basis conclusions require symmetric Cartan data with d_i=1, characteristic zero, and the same finite loopless quiver geometric parameters Q_ij=(−1)^(h_ij)(u−v)^(h_ij+h_ji) as the generic supplier. Raw first-strand/right-append extension represents π_Λ composed with quantum star; mirroring removes star.

The integral projective identification assumes inherited AC. Its negative-half kernel uses all divided right powers beyond the highest limits: Σ_i Σ_(s>λ_i) U_A^-F_i^(s). Ordinary word classes need not span integrally, and quantum factorials are not inverted in A.

load_bearing.statement: For the stated formal minimal-parabolic category over every degree-zero field and admissible homogeneous Q, reduced matchings with open dots and positive far-left bubbles form a basis, and the universal graded flag models are jointly faithful at each fixed physical source weight. For dominant Λ and monic a_j of degree λ_j, the representable ideal has exact downward intersection e(v)I_a(β)e(u); its completed quotient is equivalent to finite right cyclotomic word projectives, transporting induction and both adjunction maps. Arbitrary monic field specialization gives the ungraded conclusions.

For every i and β, R^Λ(β+α_i)e(β,i) is projective as a right R^Λ(β)-module and its reflected bimodule is projective on the left. Basic induction and restriction are exact and preserve finite graded projectives. For an R^Λ(β)-module M there is the functorial generic-to-cyclotomic exact sequence 0→q^((α_i|2Λ−β)) barred F_i M→F_i M→F_i^Λ M→0.

Over any field, for a real symmetrizable datum with finite color set and homogeneous Q satisfying (Q1)–(Q4), every dot in each monic cyclotomic block has a scalar monic annihilator, each block is finite dimensional, and R^a(β+mα_i)=0 for sufficiently large m. Standard power specializations additionally have nilpotent dots and the induced grading; arbitrary monic specializations have the stated ungraded conclusions.

For h=⟨h_i,Λ−β⟩≥0, q_i^(−2)F_i^ΛE_i^Λ ⊕ ⊕_(k=0)^(h−1) q_i^(2k)Id ≅ E_i^ΛF_i^Λ. For h≤0, q_i^(−2)F_i^ΛE_i^Λ ≅ E_i^ΛF_i^Λ ⊕ ⊕_(k=0)^(−h−1) q_i^(−2k−2)Id. These are natural graded functor and bimodule isomorphisms; both identity sums are empty at h=0.

For every real symmetrizable Cartan datum, a chosen P-label-graded Q(q)-space with the stated toral action, root-shifting E_i,F_i, toral conjugation, mixed relations and local nilpotence uniquely becomes an integrable type-one quantum module. Every vector has a finite rank-one orbit; finite-dimensional full-g orbits are not asserted.

For any field and homogeneous real symmetrizable KLR datum satisfying the standing parameter conditions, one-step restriction of a simple with positive i-tail has one simple socle and head in the same shift orbit, and terminal-dot index exactly that tail. Induction with L(i^n) has a unique head occurring once. A simple survives the first-strand power quotient exactly when every first tail is at most λ_i; projected right induction has the surviving generic head or is zero.

For the stated arbitrary-field homogeneous KLR datum, J_i(S)=ε_i(S)+ε_i^L(S)−⟨h_i,β⟩ is finite, first-tail extraction gives strict injective elementary-crystal maps, and the simple graph is lowering-generated with every generic f_i nonzero. In any containing first-strand quotient the surviving right-i lowering length is λ_i+ε_i(S)−⟨h_i,β⟩.

For every stated standard homogeneous cyclotomic datum, the actual append bimodules have an A-bilinear cap T_i of degree t=2d_i(1−h) and a finite B-central Casimir of degree −t satisfying both dual-basis identities. They give X{t}≅HOM_A(Y,A) and E_i{t}⊣F_i⊣E_i on all graded modules. Arbitrary monic specializations retain the ungraded construction.

For any downward prefix η and distinct i,j in the stated homogeneous or ungraded monic quotient, with p=τ_(n+1)e(ηij), there is a lift-independent actual old-corner residual D_η on e(ηij)Be(ηji) such that T_iT_j(ap)=t_ji D_η(a) and T_jT_i(pa)=t_ij D_η(a). The identities include all zero-, one- and two-return terminal matchings and shorter-crossing terms.

For every stated homogeneous cyclotomic datum, actual word caps give a perfect degree-t_β regular pairing, where t_β=(β,β)−2(Λ,β). Its ordered unequal-crossing closure ratio is t_ij/t_ji. The specified diagonal inversion weights produce a perfect symmetric form, DB≅B{t_β}, and D_ψP≅P#{t_β}. Arbitrary monic specializations give the ungraded symmetric form.

For every real symmetrizable datum, canonical negative-half right extraction is strict, reversal preserves B(∞) without signs, and projection survivors are exactly c_i(b)≤λ_i for every i. The finite elementary-extraction recognition argument identifies the general homogeneous KLR simple graph with B(∞), its cyclotomic survivors with B(λ), and projective-cover labels with the same graph.

Assuming AC, for the standard homogeneous quotient over any field and arbitrary real symmetrizable datum with admissible graded parameters, there is a unique vacuum-preserving U_A-isomorphism K_0(Proj R^Λ)≅V_A(Λ), intertwining normalized operators and divided powers. The negative-half vacuum kernel is Σ_i Σ_(s>λ_i) U_A^-F_i^(s), and the projective tensor form becomes the specified normalized highest-weight contravariant form.

In the full geometric-parameter scope of the generic global theorem, raw first-strand/right-append extension satisfies φ[q_Λ(P)]=π_Λ(*(γ^−1[P])). A normalized generic indecomposable projective extends to zero or one normalized cyclotomic cover; surviving heads do not merge and all cyclotomic covers arise. FIRST/RIGHT crystal labeling cancels the two stars.
